decisions.statement: Every moment a case states is worked off the run's clock rather than frozen.
A case is named for the reading its picture is meant to show.
The near case is drawn to read forty-six minutes left under a yellow ring.
The wide case is drawn to read five hours eighteen minutes left.
That wait is the widest a caption draws.
A caption shrunk or truncated in the wide case is the defect that case is for.
A surplus already under a rung is drawn in red re-aimed at the rung under that rung.
A cost of nothing is drawn green and captioned with the readout's label.
A surplus that is not falling leaves the label and no countdown at all.
A surplus not falling still colors the cost.
That ring is red rather than yellow.
A cost carrying no surplus keeps the color the server drew it.
A surplus is stated by the wait wanted.
The figure is worked back from that wait.
Each wait counted down is also drawn in every timer form of the caption.
A case naming a widget the bundle does not ship is asked for by no coverage.
Nothing here judges an image.
A person reads the drawing.
No image was drawn where these cases were written.
That machine has no simulator.

definition: every case a render run draws of the cost tile
